title: Return Windows, Restocking and Return Methods — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders** publishes one return window per item return class and the following return terms per fulfilment program.

**Standard return window in calendar days, by item return class** (identical in every program):

| Return class | General merchandise | Electronics | Mobile phones | Large items | Non-returnable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days | 90 | 30 | 15 | 30 | 0 |

**Window anchor** (every program): the fulfilled date, which for a register sale is the purchase date, for pickup the collection date and for delivery the delivery date.

**Holiday return start** (every program): purchases ordered from 1 November through 24 December (month-day range 11-01 to 12-24) get the holiday return start of 26 December (12-26), from which the window is counted instead of the normal anchor when later; it applies to the return classes general merchandise and electronics.

| Program | Ways a return can be made | Prepaid mail return label fee | Restocking fee on an opened item returned because the customer changed their mind, percent of the refunded merchandise amount | Return classes the restocking fee applies to | Return reasons for which the fulfilment fee is refunded with the merchandise | Where a defect claim outside the window is sent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | in store | not applicable | 0 | none | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |
| Northgate Order Pickup | in store, Drive Up | not applicable | 0 | none | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |
| Northgate Drive Up | in store, Drive Up | not applicable | 0 | none | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |
| Northgate Ship to Home | in store, Drive Up, mail | 0.00 | 0 | none | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | in store, Drive Up, mail | 0.00 | 0 | none | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | home pickup, in store | not applicable | 15 | large items | defective, damaged in transit, wrong item | the manufacturer warranty or a protection plan |

"Not applicable" for the mail label fee means mail returns are not offered in that program.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An electronics item ordered on 20 November and fulfilled on 22 November counts its window from 26 December, the later date, so its 30-day window ends on 25 January; the same item ordered on 26 December counts from its own fulfilled date.
